data.name: Myer
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Myr means 'mighty, solver of problems'. It is derived from the Greek word 'myrion', which means 'ten thousand'. Myr was an ancient Greek god who was believed to have the power to solve all problems and difficulties. In the Bible, Myer is not mentioned directly, but the name is associated with the biblical figure Myrrh, a resin used in the anointing oil for Jesus' burial.
